worldcombat.skill.throatchop.summary: A thrust straight at the throat. It deals physical damage and leaves the target unable to use any sound-based move for a while.
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.use.0: Cut off an opponent's roar or sound wave
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.use.1: Punish a foe that leans on sound-based moves
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.use.2: Suppress a ranged caster at close range
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.description: The hit deals physical damage at %1$s base power.
On a hit the target cannot use any sound-based move for %1$s.
Thrust reach %1$s blocks, collision radius %2$s blocks; prepare %3$s s, recover %4$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.choke.on: Chokehold: the silence lasts x1.25, at the cost of x0.9 power, 2 more ticks of prepare and 6 more ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.choke.off: Slash: faster and x1.15 power, at the cost of a x0.75 silence.
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.throatchop.growth.0: At level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the silence extends to %3$s.
On (Chokehold): the silence lasts x1.25, but power is x0.9, prepare takes 2 more ticks and cooldown 6 more ticks. Off (Slash): faster and x1.15 power, at the cost of a x0.75 silence.
The thrust is considered only within this distance; it is a melee move, so larger distances are left to the shared approach.
